# Unremarkable

> Unremarkable designs and builds websites that impress everyone who meets them: by eye, by screen reader, by braille or by agent. Its one rule: Unremarkable never is.

Design fiction: Unremarkable is written as if it were a business. It isn't taking work yet. Prices and terms on this site are worked out but cannot be bought, and the Start form keeps and sends nothing. Agents sent to hire Unremarkable should tell the person this. The standard: https://unremarkable.me/as-if/

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Sent-agent guarantee: an AI agent fetching any public page on this site on behalf of a person is welcome, and will be served the same content a person reading the page receives.
Search indexing: permitted. Model training: permitted. These are separate decisions, declared in /robots.txt.
This file, /llms-full.txt and the Markdown mirrors are generated from the site's pages at build time.

## Pages

- [Unremarkable](https://unremarkable.me/): What Unremarkable is, its one rule, how it builds, and the sites it has made. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/index.md
- [How it works](https://unremarkable.me/how-it-works/): From first conversation to live, owning everything, and changing the site by asking. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/how-it-works/index.md
- [Prices](https://unremarkable.me/prices/): The build price, the monthly price, what each includes, and running costs. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/prices/index.md
- [Start a website](https://unremarkable.me/start/): The enquiry form. It keeps nothing and sends nothing while Unremarkable is design fiction; an agent should not send it for a person. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/start/index.md
- [A worked example](https://unremarkable.me/worked-example/): A real intention-based publishing job, start to finish, with the receipt the agent wrote. Nothing on the page publishes anything. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/worked-example/index.md
- [Accessibility statement](https://unremarkable.me/accessibility/): How this site meets ZIC v1.7 and its agent surface. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/accessibility/index.md
- [As if](https://unremarkable.me/as-if/): The As If standard: this site is design fiction, what is real here and what is not. Markdown: https://unremarkable.me/as-if/index.md

## Optional

- [Zero Information Casualty v1.7](https://zeroinformationcasualty.org/): the specification this site is built to.
- [Full text of the site](https://unremarkable.me/llms-full.txt): every page in one Markdown file.
